title: npm audit disabled in the client configuration
description: .npmrc declares an `audit=false` npm client setting. A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `audit=false` npm client setting.
remediation: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix an `audit=false` npm client setting.
limitation: It matches an `audit=false` npm client setting in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
